body.method.cun_bae.name: CUN-BAE (default)
body.method.cun_bae.summary: Estimates body fat from age, sex and BMI.
body.method.us_navy.name: U.S. Navy circumferences
body.method.us_navy.summary: Uses neck, waist/abdomen and hip tape measures.
body.method.jackson_pollock_3.name: Jackson–Pollock 3-site skinfold
body.method.jackson_pollock_3.summary: Three caliper sites; converts density with the Siri equation.
body.method.jackson_pollock_7.name: Jackson–Pollock 7-site skinfold
body.method.jackson_pollock_7.summary: Seven caliper sites; converts density with the Siri equation.
body.method.bmi_waist_height.name: BMI + waist-to-height
body.method.bmi_waist_height.summary: Wellness screening indices — not a body-fat percentage or diagnosis.
body.photo.local_only: Progress photos stay on this device and are not sent to Health apps.
body.wellness.bmi_under: BMI below the usual adult mid-range
body.wellness.bmi_mid: BMI in the usual adult mid-range
body.wellness.bmi_elevated: BMI above the usual adult mid-range
body.wellness.bmi_high: BMI in a higher adult band
body.error.invalid_height: Height must be greater than zero.
body.error.sex_required: Sex is required for this method.
body.error.missing_abdomen: Abdomen or waist circumference is required.
body.error.navy_male_geometry: Abdomen must be larger than neck for the Navy male equation.
body.error.navy_female_geometry: Waist + hip must exceed neck for the Navy female equation.
